desktopHeaded.scope: Intel UHD/D3D11; CPU delegate; real synthetic input; 92 modules

decision.reason: Desktop headed passed a full matrix and full real gesture suite, but a subsequent independent headed run could not acquire stable tracking in 12 s. Headless and 390 px matrices also reproduce gaps >250 ms, including steady state. No consistent global acceptance is established.
decision.dominantObservation: Long real detectForVideo wall-time, with measured render contention and occasional main-thread result-delivery blocking. OS/driver-exclusive attribution remains unproven.
decision.whyNoScheduler: Failures also occur after all loading ends, and a CPU headless gap of 476.2 ms remains late in the render-suspended diagnostic. A load queue change cannot be claimed to resolve this evidence.
decision.whyNoGpuDefault: GPU accelerates the minimal case but headed full-atlas CPU provides higher end-to-end throughput (140 vs 92 valid samples in the final skin-on window).
decision.nextCondition: Repeat the unchanged acceptance matrix and gestures in independently stable target sessions; correlate residual gaps with system-level scheduling/driver evidence before proposing an isolated product change.

mobile.latestFailure: Initial 15-second acceptance; later gestures were not run.

protocol.realPipeline: Photos -> canvas.captureStream -> video -> createImageBitmap -> real Worker/WASM/model -> unchanged landmarks/controllers
protocol.sourceHashNote: Early runs hashed source files at end; subsequent runs capture at start. Preserved baseline observer source matches the CPU v2 hash. Report individual limitations in the delivery document.

beforeAfter.comparisons: CPU/GPU delegates and execution environments; no product improvement claimed
